text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
This is so stupid! If it's not gonna go the
way I
want, then I don't wanna do it
anymore!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...No! No way! I'm gonna be a witch! There's no way I'm quitting!
choice_data_list: じゃあ魔女になるのもやめる？
choice_data_list_en: Then are you going to stop being a witch too?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
choice_data_list: じゃあ、レースで勝たないとな
じゃあ、レースで勝たないとね
choice_data_list_en: Then we've got to win the race.
Then we've got to win the race, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Th-that's right! It's all pointless if I
don't win! It'll
be boring and, even
worse, I won't become a
witch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm winning the next one for sure!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm winning the next one for sure!
choice_data_list: それじゃ、しっかりトレーニングしよう
choice_data_list_en: Alright, let's make sure to train hard.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm confident! 'Cause I'm
gonna make
an amazing spell to make
sure I win!
choice_data_list: それじゃ、しっかりトレーニングしよう
choice_data_list_en: Alright, let's make sure to train hard.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now, don't just stand there! Hurry up
and help me
out!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nngh... What do we need to train for?
Can't we
use magic to just get it over
with?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hm... You make it sound like you have
some
secret training planned or
something.
choice_data_list: 勝利の魔法を極めるためのトレーニングだよ
choice_data_list_en: It's training to master the magic of victory.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fine. I guess I can give it a try. But if I
still lose,
you're in big trouble!
